story_p1: Havilah Image Development Ltd is an architect-led project management practice with over 15 years of experience delivering residential, commercial, and institutional projects across Nigeria.
story_p2: We coordinate all stakeholders — from client teams to consultants and contractors — to drive clarity, accountability, and progress at every phase of a project.
story_p3: Our services are driven by seasoned professionals committed to meeting a market need for viable, safe, and profitable investment opportunities through uncompromised values: accountability, proficiency, integrity, consistency, and innovation.
